1838 is not a leap year (leap years are divisible by 4, but 1838/4=459.5).  
From 11-09-1838, add 362 days:  
First, days remaining in 1838 after Sep 11:  
Sep: 30-11=19 days left  
Oct: 31, Nov: 30, Dec: 31 → total = 19+31+30+31 = 111 days.  
362 - 111 = 251 days into 1839.  
1839 is not a leap year (not divisible by 4).  
Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31, Aug 31 → cumulative:  
31→59→90→120→151→181→212→243.  
251 - 243 = 8 days into September 1839 → September 8.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1839-09-08
